```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment=NA, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(irr)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(lsr)
```


#Data

We begin by reading in the dataset with ratings from both coders for the 1252 participants included in the main analysis. 

```{r}
d_comp <- read.csv("Study 2 coding data anonymized.csv")
```

#Liberal index

Then we compute reliability for the liberal index

```{r}
libcode <- d_comp %>%
  dplyr::select(lib.RA1, lib.RA2)
kappa2(libcode)

d_comp$lib <- (d_comp$lib.RA1 + d_comp$lib.RA2)/2
d_comp$cons <- (d_comp$cons.RA1 + d_comp$cons.RA2)/2
```

#Liberals -> Liberal Arguments

```{r}
d_lib <- filter(d_comp, party == "liberal")
d_lib_PTd <- filter(d_lib, condition == "PT-different")
d_lib_PTs <- filter(d_lib, condition == "PT-same")
d_lib_C <- filter(d_lib, condition == "control")

t.test(d_lib_PTd$lib, d_lib_C$lib, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_lib_PTd$lib, d_lib_C$lib)

t.test(d_lib_PTs$lib, d_lib_C$lib, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_lib_PTs$lib, d_lib_C$lib)
```

#Liberals -> Conservative Arguments

```{r}
t.test(d_lib_PTd$cons, d_lib_C$cons, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_lib_PTd$cons, d_lib_C$cons)

t.test(d_lib_PTs$cons, d_lib_C$cons, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_lib_PTs$cons, d_lib_C$cons)
```

\newpage

#Conservative index

Next we compute reliability for the conservative index

```{r}
conscode <- d_comp %>%
  dplyr::select(cons.RA1, cons.RA2)
kappa2(conscode)
```


#Conservatives -> Conservative Arg

```{r}
d_cons <- filter(d_comp, party == "conservative")
d_cons_PTd <- filter(d_cons, condition == "PT-different")
d_cons_PTs <- filter(d_cons, condition == "PT-same")
d_cons_C <- filter(d_cons, condition == "control")

t.test(d_cons_PTd$cons, d_cons_C$cons, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_cons_PTd$cons, d_cons_C$cons)

t.test(d_cons_PTs$cons, d_cons_C$cons, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_cons_PTs$cons, d_cons_C$cons)
```

#Conservatives -> Liberal Arg

```{r}
t.test(d_cons_PTd$lib, d_cons_C$lib, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_cons_PTd$lib, d_cons_C$lib)

t.test(d_cons_PTs$lib, d_cons_C$lib, var.equal=TRUE)
cohensD(d_cons_PTs$lib, d_cons_C$lib)
```
